summary.en: An illegal gold mine in southwestern Colombia collapsed, killing 14 miners and injuring 7, while a Colombian military helicopter crashed, leaving 19 injured. President De la Espriella has launched a total offensive against ELN and dissident FARC forces in Arauca. Ecuadorian authorities arrested four FARC dissident leaders on the border, linking the insurgent network to the Colombian crisis. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: En ulovlig gullgruve i sørvestlige Colombia kollapset, og 14 gruvearbeidere ble drept og 7 såret, mens et colombiansk militærhelikopter styrtet ned, og 19 ble skadet. President De la Espriella har lansert en total offensiv mot ELN og dissidente FARC-styrker i Arauca. Ecuadorianske myndigheter arresterte fire dissidente FARC-ledere ved grensen, og knyttet opprørsnettverket til den colombianske krisen. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
